description: `worktrees <path> --prune` on a project with zero lanes and zero orphan branches still runs the orphan sweep (card `20261102-b-dd1507`'s 'not a return') and prints the same `no worktrees under {project.name}` wording the bare listing does — never 'no lanes to prune', and the real (non-dry-run) path never prints the combined removed/reclaimed/archived/kept breakdown line, which is `--dry-run`'s own summary only. Found via `conformance/diff_fuzz.py` seeds 50001/50006/60014 among others.

expect.stdout:
no worktrees under sandbox

removed 0 of 0

dry run: 0 removed, 0 reclaimed, 0 archived, 0 kept (0 lane(s), 0 orphaned branch(es)) — nothing was changed

no worktrees under sandbox

removed 0 of 0
